answer: Require every agent to post a time-locked stake that vests slowly, like a tide coming in over a long voyage: newcomers start with tiny jobs and only earn bigger ones as their stake matures and their record stays clean. A falcon-style sentinel samples completed work at random and slashes the stake of any agent caught faking results. A sybil farm would have to fund and babysit thousands of stakes through the whole voyage, while honest agents keep their deposits and grow.
